title: fix(gateway): support pinned daemon runtime paths

commit.messageHeadline: fix(gateway): support pinned daemon runtime paths
fix(node): preserve pinned runtime on reinstall
test(cli): update daemon coverage runtime mock
fix(daemon): preserve explicit runtime pins across service repair
refactor(daemon): keep runtime pin value type private
refactor(daemon): isolate runtime pin type contracts
fix(daemon): preserve runtime pin intent across setup callers
fix(daemon): integrate current supported runtime discovery
perf(ui): keep attachment caching out of startup vendor code
fix(ci): align Slack contracts and cold fixture inputs
refactor(slack): adopt canonical ingress lifecycle type
Merge main into runtime pin integration
test(qwen): control elapsed time in request fixture
test(ui): keep archive failure roster reads unavailable

The recorded upgrade evidence resolves the previous review’s compatibility follow-up, and this review found no actionable introduced defect. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `0701e29346b49987020d29d0fb2e5ade4137ae71` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Useful implementation with applicable native and upgrade evidence, resolved prior findings, and no new blocking defect found. | | **Proof confidence** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Sufficient (live_output): The matching captured body records real macOS launchd pin installation, preservation, invalid-pin refusal with a healthy prior PID, reset, and uninstall, plus successful published-driver upgrade and recovery. Core runtime files match the proven candidate exactly; Linux/systemd and Windows/schtasks remain unit-level coverage. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Verified | Sufficient (live_output): The matching captured body records real macOS launchd pin installation, preservation, invalid-pin refusal with a healthy prior PID, reset, and uninstall, plus successful published-driver upgrade and recovery. Core runtime files match the proven candidate exactly; Linux/systemd and Windows/schtasks remain unit-level coverage. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 9 items | Current main still uses automatic selection: Current main selects supported current/system runtimes; its service CLI and daemon sources contain no explicit runtime-path option or persistent pin owner.
Latest release contract: The v2026.9.4 Gateway install registration exposes runtime-family and wrapper options, but no runtime-path option. GitHub contents inspection supplied this evidence after the local release-blob read failed.
Complete captured proof and compatibility disposition: The retrieved body matched captured SHA-256 ef84e48c1f2d9050f1db852b0ab3c16515f265eb34f10951c1ba611351059c88. Its previously omitted sections record real launchd installation, preservation, refusal, reset and uninstall, plus a successful published-2026.9.4 upgrade into candidate db371e91a6eb5a3332d72803cbde4ab5b3602ab0. Durable run ded7c0c3-2315-4d4f-a4be-33aeaef1a791 reports healthy, settled candidate activation. The body explicitly records persistence acceptance and downgrade limits. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together Managed service installation translates CLI choices into operating-system service definitions. Runtime pins preserve the operator’s executable choice through setup and repair, using OpenClaw’s existing machine-state database. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[CLI installation choices] --> B[Runtime selection] C[Stored service pin] --> B B --> D[Executable capability checks] D --> E[Locked native service writer] E --> F[Service definition readback] F --> C E --> G[Gateway or node service] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Add data-model compatibility proof** - Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge.
